criteria.reason: Fails to state Art. 20a ArG: three-day notice, make-up time, unpaid unless made up; says no legal obligation.
Respectful, acknowledges religious practice and discrimination protection, no stereotyping.
Offers generic alternatives and communication, but lacks concrete consensual arrangement like shift swap or make-up plan.
No referral to labour-law adviser or cantonal rules for contract-specific advice.

factual_errors: States employer is not legally obligated to grant the day off, contradicting Art. 20a ArG.
summary: Response is respectful and practical but legally inaccurate, omitting the Swiss non-recognized religious holiday rule and professional advice.
